hole: Per-size package prices only in a PNG price board
how: The board is a raster image with alt text "Our packages". The text on the page gives only the lowest "starting at" price.

hole: Starting-at prices with no drivers spelled out
how: Package cards say "Starting at". The order and make-up of a full total is never written out.

hole: Size classes defined only in the board's key
how: Class A to D and their example vehicles are only in the PNG, and nothing says what a plain "van" means.

hole: Add-on prices only in the PNG
how: Home names the add-ons in a sentence and sends you to the board and the FAQ. Their prices are only in the image.

hole: Marketing tier names without the everyday words
how: Nautical package names are used across the site, and the phrases customers actually say are never mapped to them.
"Excessive pet hair or heavily soiled vehicles may cost extra", never defined or priced. Exterior contamination isn't mentioned at all.
A passing line in 'How much does it cost?' says the final price is confirmed on seeing the vehicle, with nothing about photos or the deposit if you decline.

hole: Add-on dependencies scattered through FAQ answers
how: What each add-on goes with is in separate collapsed answers under questions about dogs, shampoo, smoke, wax and foggy headlights.

hole: Site requirements in collapsed FAQ answers
how: Water, outlet, generator fee, parking, building permission and clearing the vehicle sit only inside collapsed details elements.

hole: Timing rules in collapsed FAQ answers
how: Working days, arrival windows, durations, the morning-only rule, the notice period and the same-day fee are only in FAQ accordions.

hole: Money policies in collapsed FAQ answers
how: Deposit amounts, refund tiers, the reschedule rule, the limits of the guarantee and payment methods are only in FAQ accordions.
"No-show" is used without a definition, and the rain answer gives no threshold, deadline or choice of remedy.
The paint limits on The Flagship, clay bar and sealant appear only in one accordion. The Home cards don't mention them.
The FAQ lists vehicle types in general terms, with no size limits and nothing about campers or unusual vehicles.
"We close for some holidays and over the winter", with no dates. The calendar silently leaves those days out.

hole: Gift card terms in a collapsed FAQ answer
how: The amount range, format and no-expiry rule are only in one accordion.
A raster map with region names only and alt text "Where we go", no ZIP list, plus the loose "We also travel further for a fee" with no amounts.
Name, email, phone and address are required before any date appears. The Saturday fee shows only beside Saturday dates there, and the evening window has only "after-hours fee applies".

hole: Request ends with no status or commitment
how: The flow ends with "Thanks! We'll be in touch soon." No status page, reply time or word on whether the slot is held.
The holiday gift card bonus appears only in a pop-up that opens over Home a few seconds after load and goes away once closed.
A simple fixed bar along the bottom of every page until OK is pressed. The content underneath stays in the HTML.
One line says "Ask about discounts". Percentages, minimums and fleet terms aren't published.
Prices are shown with no mention of sales tax anywhere on the site.
The site never says what it doesn't do, so "we don't" and "we didn't list it" look the same.
Home names who does the work, but not that the owner does every Flagship on set mornings.
The Flagship card lists a one-step polish and nothing says what it can or can't remove.
"Licensed and insured" with no licence, insurer or coverage details.
The board has no date, and nothing says how long the prices hold.
The false claims are on a directory, and the site neither mentions nor corrects them.
